visualCharacteristics: 3-up grid, red star rating + count under title

cells: H3 title link; paragraph with star rating (e.g. '4.5 of 5 stars') and review count

usage.description: Grid of recipe cards that show a star rating and review count under the title (Fill Your Table).

reuseGuidance: Use when cards are individual recipes with ratings. Author the rating as a plain paragraph such as '4.5 of 5 stars (182)'; the block renders it as a star meter plus count. Cards without a rating paragraph still render.
